intro: Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp needs to determine whether Yenniku, the son of the Darkspear chieftain, is dead. Adventurers are asked to hunt Bloodscalp headhunters and recover their shrunken heads so Nimboya can examine them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We must find if Yenniku is dead.
Slay the Bloodscalp Headhunters and take from them their Shrunken Heads. You must gather many, many heads, and I will inspect them to make sure Yenniku's head is not among them.
And if Yenniku was killed by the Bloodscalps, then may a 600-year curse fall on the spirit of their chief, Gan'zulah!
Go, friend. You may find many Headhunters at the ruins of Zuuldaia and Zul'Kunda, along the coast to the north.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend. I fear for our chief's son. Do you have the shrunken heads so I may inspect them?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. I will inspect these heads to ensure poor Yenniku was spared the headhunter's axe.
